title: Ambaji Mata Dham Darshan
playlist: Maa Durga aur Devi ki Kathayein
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Close-up view of a white marble Hindu temple gateway and shikhar on an Aravalli hill in Gujarat, saffron flags, marigold garlands hanging at the entrance, brass diyas glowing, warm golden morning light, centered symmetrical frame
scenes.tts: अंबाजी माता के मंदिर में मूर्ति क्यों नहीं है?
scenes.sub: Ambaji Mata ke mandir mein murti kyun nahi hai?
scenes.animate: saffron flags flutter gently, the diya flames flicker softly, warm light shifts slowly

scenes.prompt: A quiet marble temple courtyard in the Aravalli hills of north Gujarat at dawn, devotees' silhouettes walking slowly with folded hands, saffron flags, soft mist over the hills, wide view
scenes.tts: अंबाजी धाम, गुजरात के बनासकांठा ज़िले में है।
scenes.sub: Ambaji Dham, Gujarat ke Banaskantha zile mein hai.
scenes.animate: soft mist drifts over the hills, saffron flags flutter gently, warm light shifts slowly

scenes.prompt: A glowing sacred niche in a temple sanctum wall decorated with red cloth, marigold and rose garlands, rows of brass diyas and an incense stick, warm golden glow, no idol, no face, no figure, no text
scenes.tts: यहाँ श्री विसा यंत्र की पूजा होती है।
scenes.sub: Yahan Shri Visa Yantra ki pooja hoti hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly, thin incense smoke curls upward, the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: Brass puja thali with a lit diya, red hibiscus flowers and marigold petals on a marble floor in front of a temple niche, soft warm light, shallow depth of field, no text
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, यह इक्यावन शक्तिपीठों में से एक है।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, yeh ikyavan Shaktipeethon mein se ek hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flame flickers softly, a few marigold petals sway gently in the warm air

scenes.tts: जय अंबे माँ! अच्छा लगे तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय अंबाजी माता!
scenes.sub: Jai Ambe Maa! Achha lage to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Ambaji Mata!
